name: Tenafly Nature Center Summer Nature Day Camp
description_short: Weekly outdoor nature camp on the Tenafly Nature Center's nearly 400 acre preserve for pre-K through grade 8, led by environmental educators: hiking, finding plants and wildlife, nature crafts and games. Half days for pre-K and kindergarten; a TNC membership is required to register.
refund_policy_summary: Refunds carry a $50 fee: full refund with 6 or more weeks' notice, half with 4 to 6 weeks, none with less than 4 weeks or once camp has begun.
special_needs_notes: Welcomes children of all abilities and works with families; staff do not give medication, so campers must be able to take their own.
swim_waterfront_notes: No swimming; water games on very hot days.
notes: A current TNC for Two membership or higher is required for every camper. Full day 9 am to 3 pm; pre-K and kindergarten half days 9 am to noon or noon to 3 pm. 2027 registration opens December 1, 2026 for Sustaining, Patron and Benefactor members and January 1, 2027 for Family and TNC for Two members. Grades 7 and 8 can join as Junior CITs; grades 9 to 12 have a CIT program. State camp ID 2248. Camp scholarships are described on a separate page.
